methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was confirmed against each provider's own live page on the accessed date; per-seat/per-user tiers record the per-user monthly price (monthly-billing rate) with a note, while flat per-account tiers are marked billingModel flat. Providers whose prices could not be confirmed on a live provider-owned page were dropped during the 2026-06-13 adversarial verification pass: Acuity Scheduling (every official acuityscheduling.com pricing URL returned HTTP 404), YouCanBook.me (live pricing page is JS-rendered and exposed plan structure/limits but no dollar figures), and Square Appointments (official squareup.com appointments pricing page is JS-rendered and exposed no figures). Doodle pricing was corrected from the official Doodle help center, which now lists Pro as a single-user plan at $15/mo ($132/yr) and Team at $19.95/mo monthly (min 2 users) / $8.95/mo annual. Quote-only Enterprise/custom tiers are recorded with monthlyUsd null, and minutesIncluded/callsIncluded/overage fields are null for every plan since they do not apply to scheduling software.

vendors.name: Calendly
vendors.provenance: https://calendly.com/pricing (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13; per-seat prices shown are annual-billing rates, monthly billing ~20% higher)

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Always free for a single user. 1 event type, 1 calendar connection, video conferencing, customizable booking page, mobile apps and browser extensions.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: $10/seat/month on annual billing (16% savings vs monthly, which is ~$12/seat). Unlimited event types, multiple calendar connections, HubSpot/Mailchimp/Stripe/PayPal integrations, Zapier and webhooks, automated reminders and outreach, 24/7 chat support.

plans.name: Teams
plans.notes: $16/seat/month on annual billing (20% savings vs monthly, ~$20/seat). All Standard features plus Salesforce integration, round-robin meetings, lead qualification/routing, Marketo/Pardot connections, advanced admin features, SSO add-on.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only / contact sales; starts at $15,000/year. All Teams features plus Salesforce routing lookup, Microsoft Dynamics, dedicated account support, SSO/SAML, domain control, audit logs, data deletion API, security reviews.

vendors.name: SavvyCal
vendors.provenance: https://savvycal.com/pricing (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13; per-user prices, 30-day money-back guarantee/free trial available)

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: $10/user/month (annual billing saves ~2 months). Unlimited calendars, unlimited scheduling links and meeting polls, team scheduling.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: $17/user/month (annual billing saves ~2 months). Everything in Basic plus custom domains, delegate to an assistant, paid bookings.

vendors.name: Doodle
vendors.provenance: https://help.doodle.com/en/articles/9457366-how-much-does-doodle-cost (official Doodle help center, accessed 2026-06-13; the public premium page is JS-rendered with no static figures, so prices were confirmed against Doodle's own help center)

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Forever-free plan with limited features (group polls, 1:1 booking) and ads.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Single-user plan: $15/month on monthly billing; $132/year (~$11/month) on annual billing (~27% off). Ad-free, high customization, priority support, company branding, multiple booking pages, Zoom/Teams/Webex/Outlook integrations.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: $19.95/user/month on monthly billing (minimum 2 users, 2-100 range); $8.95/user/month on annual billing (~55% off, billed upfront for the full year). Adds admin console, centralized billing, team management on top of Pro.

vendors.name: Cal.com
vendors.provenance: https://cal.com/pricing (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13; per-user prices shown are annual-billing rates with 25% yearly savings)

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free forever for 1 user. Unlimited event types and calendars, email & SMS notifications, 100+ app integrations, mobile app and browser extension, Stripe & PayPal payments, two-way Salesforce/HubSpot sync, Calendly import.

plans.name: Teams
plans.notes: $12/user/month on annual billing (25% yearly savings). Adds round-robin scheduling, managed & collective event types, recurring events, custom notifications, branding removal, routing forms, booking analytics, custom APIs.

plans.name: Organizations
plans.notes: $28/user/month on annual billing (25% yearly savings). Adds unlimited sub-teams, routing by custom variables, company subdomain, SAML SSO and SCIM, SOC 2/HIPAA/ISO 27001 compliance, instant meetings, domain-wide delegation, role-based permissions.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only / contact sales. Adds dedicated onboarding/engineering support, SLA & uptime guarantees, HRIS/directory integrations, priority Slack support, dedicated database.

vendors.name: Setmore
vendors.provenance: https://www.setmore.com/pricing (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13; per-user prices)

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 4 users, 200 appointments/month. Branded booking page and mobile app, email confirmations and 1 reminder, online & in-person payments, iOS/Android apps, Google reviews, Mailchimp/Zapier integrations. No SMS reminders, no 2-way calendar sync.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $12/user/month on monthly billing; $5/user/month on annual billing. Unlimited users and appointments, SMS reminders, 2-way calendar sync, recurring appointments, branding removal, HIPAA compliance with a signed BAA, API access, priority support.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only / contact sales for a custom all-in-one booking system.

vendors.name: TidyCal
vendors.provenance: https://tidycal.com/pricing (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13; flat pricing, includes one-time lifetime options)

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free forever. Unlimited bookings and booking types, paid/recurring/package bookings, booking page, 1 calendar connection. TidyCal branding shown.

plans.name: Individual Lifetime
plans.notes: $29 one-time (not recurring; monthlyUsd null). Everything in Free plus auto-created meeting links, group bookings, guest invites, AI booking assistant, custom emails, analytics, 10 calendar connections.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $12/month or $99/year (annual saves ~$45, ~31%). No TidyCal branding, custom domain, priority support, 25 calendar connections, all Individual Lifetime features.
